# 5.10 接口

# ✓接口实现测试

```
public class InterfaceExample {
    /**
     * @param args
     */
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // TODO Auto-generated method stub
        StackStorage s=new StackStorage();
        s.put("harbin");
        s.put("institutue");
        s.put("of");
        s.put("technolgy");
        System.out.println(s.get());
        System.out.println(s.get());
        System.out.println(s.get());
        System.out.println(s.get());
    }
}
```
